description.value: Coast & Country Diner and Caterers has been serving the Fraser Valley of British Columbia since 1997, offering dine-in breakfasts and a full catering operation for weddings, corporate events, and celebrations. Located in the Cloverdale neighbourhood of Surrey, the diner is known for fresh, made-to-order food and strong repeat clientele. Private event bookings are also available for groups.
